# Native grammar source pins

These npm tarballs are local, integrity-pinned build inputs. Each contains the upstream MIT license, grammar source, generated C parser, native Node binding source, and package metadata. The normal npm install script compiles its native binding for the selected Node environment; no prebuilt `.node` file is stored here. `package-lock.json` records each tarball's SHA-512 integrity. `src/install/runtime.ts` copies and hashes the installed source and binary together for candidate and installed runtime identity.

The Python patch modifies only `grammar.js`. Its `src/grammar.json`, `src/node-types.json` and `src/parser.c` were regenerated with the [official Tree-sitter v0.25.10 Linux x64 CLI](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/releases/tag/v0.25.10), reporting commit `da6fe9beb4f7f67beb75914ca8e0d48ae48d6406`. The downloaded CLI gzip SHA-256 was `8283ddba69253c698f6e987ba0e2f9285e079c8db4d36ebe1394b5bb3a0ebdfd`; decompressed binary SHA-256 was `de21a99ed95e683526b26eee456e12352752487daed0d20afc85157212ab8e3d`. The patched `grammar.js` SHA-256 is `f95e4ba0ed8718ef67d96450d55fa19eada5c3fbfbe498434a71897518cede72`, generated `parser.c` SHA-256 `fe98a691bda7639bdd935985fdac0b14d5e02019981e7d107fabc7f1b9fca1fe`, and `node-types.json` SHA-256 `50e260eda3339e92851a36c3570fdea248fe25fa0019c8698d505ef35c32f3fa`.

The C patch also modifies only `grammar.js` and uses the same official CLI to regenerate `src/grammar.json`, `src/node-types.json`, and `src/parser.c`. Its patched `grammar.js` SHA-256 is `5d3825d1322fa0c8efa05fc8f1eff1dd2ab03eef977acbc03955d15419ce30f8`, generated `parser.c` SHA-256 `ba999e6ce89d359ae62f3726408f9051a0d00e76fd3cfae0d54fd0e5d3fd8039`, and `node-types.json` SHA-256 `4ffc38a07a2b15483485741562935017f45347b6eed049a4ae2c8804f4f51b3a`.

The Kotlin patch modifies only `grammar.js` and uses the same official CLI to regenerate `src/grammar.json`, `src/node-types.json`, and `src/parser.c`. Its patched `grammar.js` SHA-256 is `1077f41a6d2edd25a49f6131a57f77d0477163f68b1ba5fdc5836fb26acb5a62`, generated `parser.c` SHA-256 `a3f1174d3f045847fc78566175362a4299c0eb07c76aaafcc38d86599637f167`, and `node-types.json` SHA-256 `c48348ffde5ecac66733ae328e1981222f9d1822f8ffc74a9581f0a11087c3a1`.

To reconstruct a tarball, check out the exact upstream commit in a clean worktree; apply the named Python, C, or Kotlin patch where applicable, then run the pinned CLI `generate` for those three patches; then run `npm pack <source-directory> --ignore-scripts`. Install with the repository lock and `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps`. The selected grammar packages have lagging peer ranges; the recorded native parser probes qualify their actual compatibility with `tree-sitter@0.25.1` on the documented host. The local tarballs avoid depending on a moving upstream branch or release registry during build.
